context.title: 1635 — The record
context.text: Spain and France returned to all-out war between 1635 and 1659.

context.title: 1685 — The record
context.text: In 1685, Louis XIV revoked the Edict of Nantes, forcing thousands of Huguenots into exile and published the Code Noir providing the legal framework for slavery and expelling Jews from French colonies.

context.title: 1756 — The record
context.text: Under the wars of Louis XV, France lost New France and most Indian possessions after its defeat in the Seven Years' War (1756-1763).

context.title: 1789 — The record
context.text: The French Revolution of 1789 overthrew the ancien régime and produced the Declaration of the Rights of Man, which expresses the nation's ideals to this day.

context.title: 1793 — The record
context.text: The monarchy was abolished and replaced by the French First Republic in September, while Louis XVI was executed in January 1793.

context.title: 1795 — The record
context.text: Weakened by external threats and internal opposition, the Republic was replaced in 1795 by the Directory.

debates.question: Was the order necessary?
debates.hook: The government called it stability; the record shows what it cost.
debates.stakes: If the order was necessary, the cost is a price; if it was not, the cost is the charge.
debates.uncomfortable: Both sides can cite the same night; the difference is who they believe was counted.
debates.whatWouldChange: A contemporaneous security assessment that named a specific threat, not a general one.

caseFor.claim: They say a law presuming officers acted in self-defense is needed so that police are not automatically suspected of using disproportionate force.

Activists say the measure would amount to a "license to kill." They argue it would hamper the opening of investigations and make holding security forces accountable even harder, in a country where alleged police brutality cases rarely reach a criminal court.

debates.question: Did the machine stay inside the law?
debates.hook: A proclamation is a sentence; the arrests, censors and tribunals are the grammar.
debates.stakes: A legal emergency and a legal cover are hard to tell apart from inside the machinery.
debates.uncomfortable: The courts that could have checked the order were part of the order's design.
debates.whatWouldChange: A court ruling that struck the order down while it was still in force.

caseFor.claim: With so many students ripe for radicalization after being forced to study in such miserable conditions, change was necessary and inevitable.
The movement was supported primarily by populists on both sides of the political spectrum, but rarely by moderates.

caseAgainst.claim: According to the Canadian Anti-Hate Network (CAHN), there is a direct link between the Yellow vests protesters in Canada and 2022 Canada convoy protests, also known as the Freedom Convoy 2022.
The French systematically used torture and repression, including extrajudicial killings to keep control.

debates.question: Who paid for the turn?
debates.hook: The figures in the record are official; the people behind them are not.
debates.stakes: A count can be accurate and still be a way of not looking.
debates.uncomfortable: The film can show the register; it cannot show the cell.
debates.whatWouldChange: A verified register of every person detained, with dates and outcomes.

caseFor.claim: An opinion poll conducted after 1 December events found that 73 per cent of French people supported the gilets jaunes and that 85 per cent were opposed to the violence in Paris.

caseAgainst.claim: Freedom of religion is constitutionally guaranteed by the 1789 Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen.

debates.question: What did the record settle?
debates.hook: An inquiry writes the first draft of the argument, not its last word.
debates.stakes: If the record is complete, the debate is about judgment; if it is not, it is about the record.
debates.uncomfortable: The commission had the power to recommend, not the power to punish.
debates.whatWouldChange: A prosecution that survived the change of government.
